response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean;
